positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Leads frontend development for a pharmacy appeals platform using Angular, optimizing user workflows for the Employer & Individual segment
-Develops and deploys .NET Core APIs with SQL Server, utilizing CI/CD pipelines for automated delivery, and troubleshoots Docker files to ensure stable containerized builds
-Liaises with business stakeholders weekly to gather requirements and align website features with goals

positions.title: Technology Development Program Associate
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Rotation 1:
-Engineered Azure Logic Apps workflows to automate email distribution of Power BI reports
-Utilized Power BI to make various enhancements to current Optum dashboards
-Proactively upskilled in Snowflake, Logic Apps, and Power BI through structured coursework to support ongoing team initiatives


Rotation 2: 
-Developed core features of the Magnus Open-Ended Chatbot using React, Python, and MongoDB, collaborating with others in the Technology Development Program
-Designed an award-winning analytics product during a company-wide hackathon, leveraging behavioral data to deliver novel insights
-Managed and mentored a hybrid team of high school interns, fostering skill development and collaboration on real-world projects

positions.title: TDP Intern
positions.description:
-Developed and deployed DOMO dashboards for cybersecurity teams to track and visualize key performance metrics, enhancing reporting efficiency
-Delivered recurring presentations to leadership and authored documentation to ensure long-term dashboard maintainability post-internship
